chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ashari, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Sulayman ibn Rashid, from his father, from Muawiya ibn Ammar who said:

I mentioned one of the prophets in the presence of Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) and I blessed him, so he said: When one of the prophets is mentioned, then begin with the blessing upon Muhammad, then upon him.
May God bless Muhammad and his family, and all the prophets.

key_terms.الأنبياء: The prophets of God from Adam to Muhammad
key_terms.الصلاة: Salawat, sending blessings upon the Prophet and his family

ai.seo_question: What is the etiquette of blessing the prophets in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) taught the proper etiquette of sending blessings: when any prophet is mentioned, one should first send blessings upon Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) before blessing that prophet. This was taught to Muawiya ibn Ammar, a prominent companion, who had blessed another prophet directly and was corrected.
